explore-rating.title: Push them to the limit
explore-rating.prompt: Two 500 Ω, 1 W resistors in series. Raise the voltage until the pair dissipates about 2 W, without either one going over 1 W.
hints: Each resistor gets half the power.
explore-rating.success: About 2 W: 1 W each. Equal resistors share the power equally, so two 1 W resistors can handle 2 W.

explore-double.title: Double the voltage
explore-double.prompt: Two 10 Ω resistors in series on 5 V. Double the voltage and compare the total power.
explore-double.success: 5 W at 10 V, against 1.25 W at 5 V: double the voltage, four times the power.
